messages:
nina_marketing: FYI some webinar leads never reached SDRs this morning. HubSpot shows them as "awaiting_enrichment" and SFDC left owner blank. Saw about 12 stuck from APAC run.
leo_revops: thanks. did that come from the new timezone-aware intake rule we shipped last week?

tess_eng: digging in. intake webhooks arrived and enrichment started, but enrichment svc returned a 202 with no ETA and our routing lambda treats 202 as 'defer' which excludes the lead from RR until enrichment_complete=true.
omar_sdr: so leads sat in limbo? sales saw nothing?
nina_marketing: correct. customers pinged. some were hot trial signups, so we lost a bit of momentum.
leo_revops: that's bad. short-term we need a fallback that ignores defer after N seconds and assigns to oncall pool. long-term change the enum semantics so 202 != blocker.
tess_eng: propose N=20s. enrichment is usually <3s but occasional spikes to 30s when API throttles. 20s balances timeliness and quality.
omar_sdr: 20s sounds ok. prefer shorter if possible. reps hate late cold pings.
leo_revops: set alert: fallback assignments >3% in 30m -> page oncall. also track conversion delta for fallback-assigned leads.
tess_eng: I'll push a quick patch to the routing lambda in canary that treats status=defer as advisory and assigns fallback after 20s. snippet:
```
// routing lambda change
if (lead.enrichment_status === 'defer') {
  if (now - lead.enrichment_started_at > 20000) {
    assignOwner('oncall_sdr_pool', lead, 'fallback_timeout')
  } else {
    continueRoundRobin(lead)
  }
}
```
leadflow_bot: Deploy queued: routing-lambda v3.1.2-canary -> 2 nodes. CI passed.
deploy_bot: Canary deploy complete; 2/2 nodes healthy.
tess_eng: canary test: fired 8 test leads with defer status, after 20s 7/8 went to oncall pool. one followed enrichment and got proper score.
leo_revops: good. also please add analytics event `fallback_due_to_defer` with tags region, campaign, origin. we need dashboards.
nina_marketing: I'm going to modify HubSpot workflow to set owner when empty immediately on intake so at least HubSpot shows an owner and notification goes out. I'll label those as `hs_auto_assigned=true`.
leo_revops: remember to keep HS assignment consistent with SFDC mapping so owners sync. we had a mapping miss where HS owner id didn't match SFDC queue and leads dropped.
tess_eng: noted. I'll validate the owner mapping script.
leadflow_bot: Alert: inbound-handoff-sla breach rate increased to 5.1% between 07:10-07:40 UTC; mitigation in canary applied.
omar_sdr: will monitor Slack and flag any rep complaints. also ask salesops to double-check the SFDC owner queue mapping.
leo_revops: next steps: 1) prod rollout of routing-lambda change in 30m (tess) 2) analytics event + dashboard (leo) 3) HubSpot workflow owner set on intake (nina) 4) mapping validation and a small script to backfill owner in SFDC for leads currently unassigned (nina + tess).
tess_eng: starting prod rollout in waves: 10%, 50%, 100% across intake regions. will watch fallback% and conversion in realtime.
leadflow_bot: Prod rollout started: routing-lambda v3.1.2 -> wave 1 10% intake.
leadflow_bot: Wave 2 -> 50% intake.
leadflow_bot: Wave 3 -> 100% intake; monitoring metrics.
leadflow_bot: Metric: fallback_due_to_defer = 2.8% (last 30m). SLA alert threshold 3% not breached.
leo_revops: great. schedule a retro tomorrow to make `defer` semantics explicit in our docs and to add unit tests for intake state machine. also let's run a 48h conversion cohort on fallback vs normal assigned leads.
nina_marketing: will do. created a small playbook for SDRs: if auto-assigned `hs_auto_assigned=true`, wait for enrichment update before heavy outreach unless lead is marked trial=true. added to #sales-ops.
marc_sfdc_bot: Backfill job started: assign owner where HS owner set but SFDC blank.
tess_eng: backfill completed, 11 leads assigned. closing ticket after 48h conversion check.
omar_sdr: thanks team. :thumbsup:
leo_revops: thanks everyone. retro invite sent for 10am PT.
leadflow_bot: Thread closed by system after 48h without SLA regressions.
